🧵🧵MYTH vs. FACT: The Left is lying about Medicaid, work requirements & rural hospitals. Here’s the truth ⤵️

❌MYTH: “Republicans are slashing Medicaid and kicking people off coverage.”
✅ FACT: False. No one who is eligible for Medicaid is being removed. We are targeting fraud, waste, and abuse — including states improperly paying benefits to illegals.

❌MYTH: “Republicans are targeting rural hospitals.”
✅ FACT: False. Republicans are protecting funding for rural hospitals while ensuring Medicaid dollars go to patients — not to administrative bloat or non-health-related programs.

FACT CHECK: Medicaid spending isn’t being cut—it’s actually going UP.

The Left wants you to believe conservatives are “slashing Medicaid,” but that’s false. No one eligible is losing coverage.

Taxpayers deserve honesty. The only thing we’re cutting is abuse. https://t.co/wldBXpXpCI

Republicans are fighting to preserve Medicaid for those who truly need it. 

Work requirements for able-bodied adults are common sense—and the majority of Americans agree.

Amazing work by @SecRollins @SecKennedy @DrMakaryFDA and the Trump Administration.

Let’s keep moving toward a future where taxpayer-funded nutrition benefits support nutrition, not junk food.
